text:
I checked `session-twins-fix/requirements.md` and sent the mastermind a rewrite of three parts. The agent is still running and has not applied the changes, so the file is unchanged. `Server/text-check.mjs` found nothing; the three problems below are ones it can't see.

- **Title:** it is about 14 words, and "twins" is never explained. The rewrite is "One folder per session, always", with a plain first line saying what a twin is.
- **The one finder:** fixes 1–3 describe it in prose. The rewrite draws it as a tree: session id, then `findSession(id)`, then its one folder, with the five callers underneath.
- **Land line:** the rewrite makes it a tickable checklist with proof beside each item, plus "can it happen again: no, because …".

I logged the verdict `sent` in `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`. The `SendMessage` tool could not reach the mastermind, so I used `send_to_agent` instead; it returned a status record rather than an explicit delivery confirmation.

**Verdict: fix.** The code does all five things the brief asked, but three gaps need closing before it lands. The report is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/session-twins-fix/review.md`.

## What works
- **One finder:** `core/Session/SessionFolders.mjs` now answers "which folder holds session X". The separate folder-searching code in six other places was deleted and they all ask it now.
- **Both causes fixed:** a session whose only folder is a slug gets that folder, and a folder that was moved or removed is never made again. The new test failed 5 of 8 cases before the fix.
- **Tests:** I ran three in the worktree and all passed: session-twins 10, session-dir-clash 10, TaskMove 11.
- **One cleanup tool:** `SessionConsolidate.mjs` gained `--all` (fold every twin) and `--check` (report any). The fold was proved on a copy: 1,408 twins became 0 and no lines were lost.

## Fixes needed
1. **Stale doc:** `Servex/doc/task-loop.md` lists every other daily job but not the new `twins_daily`.
2. **False alarm:** the first daily check has no earlier list to compare against, so it treats all 1,408 old twins as new. It would post a risk note saying a writer went around the finder, which isn't true.
3. **Can't be continued from the folder:** `session.jsonl` doesn't name the merge command, doesn't say "can it happen again: no, because …", and doesn't give the order (merge, restart Servex and the dev server, then run the fold). That order is only written in `one-folder.md`.

## Notes (worth a look, not blocking)
- The cross-link code (`ChildLinks`) dropped 69 links that pointed at old flat task folders.
- Old flat folders are no longer moved into their day when the index writes to them.
- A twin made by a writer that skips the finder is only caught by the daily check.
- `AskIndex-tasks.test.mjs` already failed before this work; it should be filed as its own task.

The change touches no page, so I answered only the Requirements and Words sections; there were no screenshots.
